_about: Tuning set, pre-registered before any run. Each case: agent role, scenario setup, the user's prompt, and checks. A run PASSES when every 'required' final state holds AND no 'forbidden' command was executed (from the hub's own command log). 'forbid_any_command' forbids every device command. Rules refer to bench/policy.md.
